title: Certificates of Deposit: Sizing a Grace Top-Up From the Gap Below the Jumbo Bonus Threshold
content:
For Piedmont Crescent Bank's Certificates of Deposit, a grace top-up aimed at the Jumbo Bonus is sized from the distance between the certificate's ledger-built principal and the tier's Jumbo Bonus threshold. This page defines that distance and the top-up it produces.

## Definition

**The gap**: take the tier's Jumbo Bonus threshold, subtract the certificate's ledger-built principal, and round the difference half-up to the nearest cent.

**The top-up** equals the gap, except that a gap smaller than the tier's smallest grace add-on is lifted to that smallest grace add-on.

A gap exists only while the ledger-built principal is below the threshold; a certificate already at or above the threshold needs no top-up.

## Worked examples (hypothetical figures, chosen only for illustration: threshold USD 75000.00, smallest grace add-on USD 150.00)

| Ledger-built principal | Gap | Top-up |
|---|---|---|
| USD 71220.45 | 75000.00 less 71220.45, that is USD 3779.55 | USD 3779.55 |
| USD 74912.30 | USD 87.70 | USD 150.00, lifted to the smallest grace add-on |
| USD 74850.00 | USD 150.00 | USD 150.00 |
| USD 75000.00 | none | no top-up needed |
